scope: Previously existing original AQA Chemistry mock-eligible single-direction reaction-equation recall flashcards; no new questions. Covers AS redox, ionisation, energetic equations and school-taught A2 Born-Haber, atomisation, electron affinities, formation, solution and hydration.
source: Actual main 3345-card original deck, real browser evaluator before v346, first-school Chemistry mock setting.
method: For every explicit chemistry equation prompt with exactly one rightward reaction arrow, generate the exact reversed two-side equation. The general similarity scorer previously treats most reversed equations as correct because all species remain present. Add a narrowly scoped check that rejects only such exactly reversed directions, allowing original models, original accepted variants and all other unfamiliar responses to continue through normal marking.
guardRestrictions: Front specifically says equation or relevant ionisation/atomisation/hydration step
Exactly one rightward reaction arrow in model and answer
Reject only when model reactants and products match input products and reactants exactly after harmless scientific typography normalisation
Do not apply to equilibrium double-arrow questions, general prose, Mathematics vectors or Physics graph arrows
limitations: Does not validate all possible rearranged chemistry equations, molecular charge balances or examiner-accepted state omission.
No whole-specification audit is inferred from this selected equation subset.
Stable core card IDs and cloud progress preserved.
